dialogues.speaker: Researcher's Notes
dialogues.text: "This is a very interesting Ruin mechanism indeed..."

dialogues.speaker: Researcher's Notes
dialogues.text: "...I shall assign a number to each of these cubes' positions. One shall be north, east shall be two. South three, and West, four..."

dialogues.speaker: Researcher's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Adding on another four for those cubes with floating stone slates on them gives us five through eight..."

dialogues.speaker: Researcher's Notes
dialogues.text: "...The sole empty position shall be nine, thus making up our nine-slotted puzzle..."

dialogues.speaker: Researcher's Notes
dialogues.text: "...The lights on the stones don't seem to mean much. In that case..."

dialogues.speaker: Researcher's Notes
dialogues.text: "Now then, let's try to make the sum of the numbers along the horizontal, vertical, and diagonal lines the same..."

dialogues.speaker: Researcher's Notes
dialogues.text: "And eureka, I've solved it! Well, that's another entry for my thesis..."

dialogues.speaker: Researcher's Notes
dialogues.text: "I should continue west and see if there are any other ruins."
